"2D A Tetris game. Where it's kind of RPG style. Where every 2 lines you complete sends an extra line to your opponent below. And 3 lines sends 2 lines to your opponent. Doing Tetris making 4 lines will sends 4 lines to the oponent. T-spin single It would send 2 lines to the opponent. A double T-spin would send 4 lines, and a triple T-spin would send 6 lines to the opponent. And it possesses magic that can help or hinder the opponent. Like clearing a line, another, and leaving every piece being played further to the right or left, which can leave no gaps.Use a barrier that protects against attacks or magic from an opponent for a period of time. And several others.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D RPG-style Tetris duel with attack lines and magic spells.

## Requirements
- Clear 2 lines to send 1 line; 3 lines to send 2; 4 lines to send 4.
- T-spin single sends 2 lines, double sends 4, and triple sends 6.
- Include spells that help or hinder the opponent, such as skewing their pieces, plus a temporary defensive barrier.
- Build directly without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game named RuneStack with a simulated AI opponent.
- Added three spells: Emberfall burns an enemy row, Aegis Veil blocks attacks for 8 seconds, and Widdershins skews three enemy spawns.
- Added combo bonuses, mana earned from line clears, responsive touch controls, and keyboard controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game UI and gameplay in `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js`.
- Added attacks, T-spin attack scoring, garbage rows, opponent AI, spells, pause/restart, score, timer, and combat log.
- Checked JavaScript syntax with `node --check game.js`.
- Ran the game in Playwright, tested starting, moving, dropping a piece, and casting Widdershins.
- Captured desktop and mobile screenshots.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Optionally test line-clear and T-spin attack mappings and inspect the latest UI after the favicon change.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game markup and controls.
- `styles.css`: Desktop and mobile presentation.
- `game.js`: Game engine, opponent, attacks, spells, and input handling.
- `screenshots/rune-stack.jpg`: Desktop screenshot.
- `screenshots/rune-stack-mobile.jpg`: Mobile screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Playwright smoke test showed score incremented to `000030` after a move and hard drop; Widdershins reduced mana from 3 to 0 and showed `HEXED ×3`.
- Spell costs are 2 mana for Emberfall and Aegis Veil, 3 for Widdershins.
